title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Navigation history and richer Android insights
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.10.0 adds Android Studio-style navigation history, a broader set of Kotlin and Android code insights, and resource diagnostics that surface broken R references directly in the editor.

highlights.title: Navigation History
highlights.description: Back, Forward, and Clear History commands let you retrace jumps between definitions, implementations, and usages the way Android Studio does — without losing your place.

highlights.title: Android Code Insights
highlights.description: New const val folding, suspend call markers, version catalog hover, override/implement gutter icons, and R.color folding bring more visual context to Kotlin and Android code.

highlights.title: Resource Diagnostics
highlights.description: Unresolved R.string and R.color references are now flagged directly in the editor, catching broken Android resource lookups before runtime.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added Android Studio-style navigation history with Back, Forward, and Clear History commands, making it easier to retrace jumps between definitions, implementations, and usages.
Added const val folding, suspend call markers, version catalog hover, override/implement gutter indicators, and R.color resource folding for richer in-editor context on Kotlin and Android projects.
Added resource diagnostics that flag unresolved R.string and R.color references inline, surfacing broken Android resource lookups directly in the editor.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed Go to Class Implementation and related navigation commands so they register reliably and open the target editor correctly during navigation flows.
Fixed parser, definition, and hover edge cases involving string interpolation, Android R.type.name references, inherited properties, and same-file symbol resolution.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Added a dedicated browser entrypoint with browser-safe stubs, bringing web-hosted installs closer to feature parity with the desktop extension for supported features.
Expanded the automated CI test suite with a comprehensive real-world Kotlin/Android project, improving confidence in parser correctness across a wider range of code patterns.
